datasets.name: isidore-index
datasets.description: Every book record in the St. Isidore (isidore.co) Calibre library, normalized: canonical languages, author era, and deep links. Files stay on isidore.co.

fields.title: title as catalogued
fields.curated_author_ids: ids of matching pages in authors.json
fields.catalog_year: Calibre pubdate year; often a scan or reprint date, NOT evidence of copyright status
fields.subjects: Calibre tags (up to 6, most common first)

datasets.name: isidore-folders
datasets.description: Every author folder in the isidore.co CalibreLibrary, with links to curated author pages where confident.

fields.name: folder name (Calibre author)
fields.curated_author_id: matching page in authors.json, if any

datasets.name: authors
datasets.description: Curated Catholic authors (476) in 12 eras, with Wikidata QIDs and cross-links.

fields.name: display name
fields.born: birth year (number; approximate for early figures)
fields.dates_display: precise display form where sources differ
fields.wikidata_qid: Wikidata item for the person, verified via the enwiki sitelink
fields.wikidata_work_qid: for anonymous authors: Wikidata item of the work

datasets.name: editions
datasets.description: “Which edition?” guide: recommended translations and editions of Catholic classics, with verified ISBNs.

datasets.name: doctors-free-texts
datasets.description: Key works of the 38 Doctors of the Church with free full-text links and per-edition rights status.

fields.rights: rights status of the linked edition (US PD = before 1931)
fields.gap: note when no free PD English text was found

datasets.name: rare-works
datasets.description: Rare & Obscure: 122 forgotten Catholic works in digital archives, grouped by theme.

fields.author: author (archive metadata)
fields.links: labelled links (files are linked only for PD items)

datasets.name: projects
datasets.description: Projects & Translations: 73 Catholic digital projects with AI-assisted work labelled (flagged entries excluded).
